validity.researcher_notes: The same Aug-2024 PNGRB register that confirms the 90 km Sugen line (Sr 19.40.NGPL, see above) ALSO carries a separate, already-operational authorisation in its 'Operational Dedicated Natural Gas Pipelines' table: Sr 19.04.NGPL, 'PLL Dahej Terminal to DGEN Power Plant, Dahej SEZ' — Entity TPL, authorised 27.08.2012, 13.00 km, 8.00 MMSCMD, operating length 13.00 km. GEM's PipelineName ('PLL-DGEN-Sugen') names both DGEN and Sugen, but the register treats these as TWO SEPARATE, differently-sized, differently-dated authorisations (13 km operational since 2012 vs 90 km still under construction as of the register's data), not one combined line. The sheet's single row, with LengthKnownKm=90.00 matching only the Sugen authorisation, appears to represent the Sugen line alone despite its name — the 13 km DGEN spur may be a genuinely missing row rather than folded into this one. This is an existence/classification question, not a length_ratio fix, so I am flagging it rather than acting on it.
